data.one_liner: Provides an easy way to add skeleton text loading animations in Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: It provides a SkeletonAnimation widget that can wrap around any child widget to apply a customizable shimmer loading animation. Developers can configure parameters like shimmer color, duration, border radius, and animation curves.
use_when: You need skeleton loading placeholders for text or images while data is fetching.
You want simple wrapper-based shimmer animations without complex setup.
avoid_when: You need a comprehensive layout placeholder system with pre-built shapes for lists, avatars, and cards.
You require advanced skeleton state controllers or complex shimmer layouts.
strengths: Easy to use by wrapping any widget with SkeletonAnimation
Customizable shimmer duration, color, and border radius
weaknesses: Requires manual wrapping of individual UI elements to build complex skeletons
Limited to basic shimmer animations compared to dedicated layout placeholder packages

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: A popular alternative for adding shimmering effect loading animations to any widget in Flutter.

data.minimal_example:
SkeletonAnimation(
  shimmerColor: Colors.grey,
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
  child: Container(
    height: 30,
    width: 100,
    color: Colors.grey[300],
  ),
)
